html_step.description: HTML-mode step (LoadRunner web_link, web_image, web_submit_form, web_image_check) resolved against the page this virtual user last loaded, instead of target: {kind: link (text), image (alt and/or src; follows the enclosing link, the single area of its image map, or submits the form of an input image), image_check (passes when the page has the image; no request), or form (fields and hidden [{name, value}], optional action and submit [{name, value}]); ordinal (1-based), case_insensitive}.
